prompt:
Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Generate 5 ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question, each with a short title and a description of one or two sentences. Sample the ideas from the full distribution of possible responses, and give each idea its estimated probability of being generated (a number between 0 and 1).

ideas.title: Longitudinal ATAC-seq/CUT&RUN of AP-1 occupancy after transient stimulus
ideas.description: Profile chromatin accessibility and AP-1 (FOS/JUN) binding at timepoints during and long after a transient stimulus (e.g., wounding, inflammation, stress) to see whether AP-1-dependent accessible sites persist after the signal and AP-1 levels have returned to baseline.

ideas.title: Secondary challenge (priming) assays with AP-1 perturbation
ideas.description: Expose cells to a first stimulus, rest them, then re-stimulate and measure transcriptional response magnitude/kinetics by RNA-seq; compare with AP-1 dominant-negative (A-FOS), CRISPRi, or degron cells to test whether AP-1 is required for faster or stronger memory responses.

ideas.title: Acute AP-1 degradation at different times to separate establishment from maintenance
ideas.description: Use inducible degrons (dTAG/auxin) on FOS/JUN to remove AP-1 either during the priming stimulus or after memory is established, then assay whether memory-associated accessibility and gene expression persist without AP-1, distinguishing initiating from maintaining roles.

ideas.title: Single-cell multiome and lineage tracing of memory inheritance
ideas.description: Perform single-cell RNA+ATAC with lineage barcodes or live-cell AP-1 reporters to test whether AP-1 activity state and its chromatin footprint are inherited through cell divisions and correlate with heterogeneous memory responses among sister cells.

ideas.title: Histone mark and SWI/SNF (BAF) dependence at AP-1 sites
ideas.description: Measure H3K27ac, H3K4me1 and BAF occupancy at AP-1 motif-containing enhancers before, during, and after stimulation, and test with BAF inhibitors or enhancer motif mutation/dCas9 editing whether these marks and AP-1-driven opening are necessary and sufficient for persistence.
